subject.title: [Feature/RFC]: Add eval-backed option discovery to avoid premature convergence in route/strategy answers

question: Should OpenClaw make eval-backed option discovery a default invariant for confident route, strategy, and choice recommendations?
rationale: The requested behavior is plausible and adjacent infrastructure exists, but it changes default answer strategy and tool-use cost without a current tested contract.

options.title: Approve eval-first invariant
options.body: Define the behavior narrowly, add a deterministic QA scenario first, and only then consider a minimal prompt/runtime change.

options.title: Keep it opt-in
options.body: Route this to a research/best-insight profile or skill so default turns do not add broader search cost.

options.title: Decline core default
options.body: Treat the incident as model-level answer quality rather than an OpenClaw-owned runtime invariant.

recommendation.title: Approve eval-first invariant
recommendation.body: Define the behavior narrowly, add a deterministic QA scenario first, and only then consider a minimal prompt/runtime change.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history puts this person on the central Codex/prompt boundary files, and the decision is primarily about OpenClaw default behavior scope.
